Definition: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jabesh = "dry"; n pr loc; 1) a town in the territory of Gilead; according to Eusebius, it is beyond the Jordan, 6 miles (10 km) from Pella, on the mountain road to Gerasa; site unknown but may be modern 'Wadi Yabes'; n pr m; 2) father of Shallum, the 15th king of the northern kingdom
